My Magic Busy Book – 36 little missions to match, sort, count & play

Meet Leo the Little Explorer! He needs your little one's help across six colourful worlds – Colour Kingdom, Animal Island, Number Town, Feelings Forest, Everyday Village and Adventure Land. Print the pages at home, cut out the cards, and enjoy screen-free play together, again and again.

What your child can do

  • Match rainbow drops to clouds, shapes to shadows and animals to their homes
  • Sort flowers by colour, food onto supermarket shelves and things into the right rooms
  • Count balloons, cupcakes and cookies, and put number cards 1–10 in order
  • Build a funny robot, a sandwich and a little castle from large picture pieces
  • Talk about everyday life – morning routines, the weather, feelings and kind ways to help
  • Imagine – dress Teddy, make Leo's face show a feeling and finish the Grand Finale adventure

What you receive

  • 48-page printable PDF in two sizes: US Letter (8.5 × 11 in) and A4 (210 × 297 mm)
  • 36 activity boards: 26 use reusable cut-out cards and 10 need no cutting at all (finger, crayon or dry-erase pen)
  • 5 cut-out sheets with 97 large cards (each 1.55 in / 39 mm square), clearly labelled with a piece ID and the page they belong to
  • Grown-up setup guide, Mission Map, answer key, certificate and reward stars
  • A separate Start Here printing guide (PDF)

Please note

  • This is a digital product. No physical item will be shipped. Files are available to download after purchase.
  • Adult assembly required. An adult prints the pages and cuts out the cards.
  • Scissors, paper or card stock, and optional laminating materials or reusable fasteners are not included.
  • The book contains detachable paper pieces. Age guidance: 3–5 years with adult supervision. Not suitable for children under 3.
  • Lamination and hook-and-loop dots or reusable adhesive are optional extras – the book works on plain paper.
  • Licence: personal / single-household use. Please don't share or resell the files.
  • Product images show the actual pages; book-style images are digital mockups, not photographs of a printed product.

Print at Actual size / 100% so the cards fit the boards. Questions? Use the contact details on our store's Contact page.
